Definition: Jehovah-Nissi, a symbolical name of an altar in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Jehovah-nissi is the name Moses gave to the altar he built after the defeat of Amalek at Rephidim. The name means the LORD is my banner, and the altar stands as the memorial of the day when Moses held up his hands and Israel prevailed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the LORD is my banner, and the battle is won by the hands held up in prayer. My position is that the altar at Rephidim is the pattern of every victory, that God fights for His people when they look to Him.
